_comment: Adeptus Mechanicus army-rule citations (10e). Currently only Doctrina Imperatives — the Command-phase pick that swings the army between a +1-to-hit ranged stance (Protector) and a +1-to-hit melee stance (Conqueror), with the unpicked attack type taking a symmetric -1 to hit for the turn.

simulator.doctrina_imperatives.quoted_text: At the start of your Command phase, select one of the following Doctrina Imperatives to be active for your army until the start of your next Command phase: Protector Imperative — each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model from your army makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll; each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model from your army makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. Conqueror Imperative — each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model from your army makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll; each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model from your army makes a ranged attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
simulator.doctrina_imperatives.trigger: start of own Command phase; the AdMech player selects exactly one of Protector / Conqueror, active until the start of their next Command phase. SwegHammer collapses 'until next Command phase' to 'for this round' since the simulator's round boundary aligns with both players' Command phases.
simulator.doctrina_imperatives.effect: Sets Army.doctrina_imperative to 'protector' or 'conqueror' for the round. In Unit.attack, when the attacker's faction is 'Adeptus Mechanicus' and its army has an imperative active: Protector lowers hit_target by 1 (cap 2+) on ranged attacks and raises it by 1 (cap 6+) on melee; Conqueror is the symmetric inverse. Faction-gated so a non-AdMech unit in the same battle is unaffected.
